# Postgres trigger matrix — every client (QA dumps)

Which PG triggers exist at which client, and whether their logic is the same.
Rows = (table, trigger) with the tenant prefix normalized to `<t>_`. Cells: same letter in a
row = **identical behaviour**: same events, same WHEN guard and same function body
(whitespace/comments/tenant prefix ignored). A different letter means the trigger or its
function differs, so diff both before porting a fix. `·` = trigger absent.
**`off`** = the trigger exists but is DISABLED in that DB (`ALTER TABLE … DISABLE TRIGGER`), so it
never fires there. Check this before blaming a trigger.
Sources: `customers/*/db/**/postgres_schema.sql`; per-client detail in each `db/SCHEMA_MAP.md`.

Snapshots (all QA unless noted in the dump header): AEO 2026-10-01, AEO/aer 2026-10-01, AEO/tsn 2026-10-01, AEO/uns 2026-10-01, BELK 2026-10-01, BOD 2026-10-01, EE 2026-10-01, EXP 2026-10-01, GAP 2026-10-01, KW/ann 2026-10-01, KW/atfs 2026-10-01, KW/loft 2026-10-01, KW/los 2026-10-01, LP 2026-10-01, TB 2026-10-01, TRD 2026-10-01
